title: Brown tells Josh Reynolds the Philadelphia Experiment was inflated

tellings.quote: After all, Brown actually told his friend Josh Reynolds, who worked closely with him, that the Philadelphia Experiment book and later movie were greatly inflated.

plain: The Philadelphia Experiment, a story of a secret 1943 Navy experiment in Philadelphia later told in a book and a movie, was greatly inflated, according to the scientist Townsend Brown himself. Michels says Brown told this to his friend Josh Reynolds, who worked closely with him. It matters because Brown is often linked to that story, and here he is said to play it down.
